name: Kepler-93
description: Star of 5,669 K, 95.9 parsecs away, with 1 transiting planet.

text.card: Kepler-93 b crosses Kepler-93 as seen from Earth, which is how it was found.
text.introduction: Its radius and temperature follow Bonomo et al. 2023.

quotes.title: Kepler-93b
quotes.card: Kepler-93b (KOI-69b) is a hot, dense transiting Super-Earth exoplanet located approximately 313 light-years away in the constellation of Lyra, orbiting the G-type star Kepler-93.
quotes.introduction: Its discovery was announced in February 2014 by American astronomer Geoffrey Marcy and his team.

notes: Kepler-93 c: found without a transit, and no paper's row measures its whole orbit together (period, eccentricity, periastron time and an inclination with an error bar) (found by radial velocity)
